title: Beyond my expectations
text: I had 1 hour relaxing massage adjusted to my needs as Im pregnant. It was done by Maria Jesus -  truly human, lovely person, very attentive and approachable, highly professional. She created very  positive environment and made sure I feel comfortable.  I was able to get an appointment at short notice and it was one of the best massages I've had recently. I enjoyed and felt very welcome. Overall it was amazing experience. Definitely will come back again.
author: krisiak23

title: Just what I needed
text: I was able to get an appointment at short notice and it was one of the best massages I've had in a while! I don't speak any Spanish and the masseuse didn't speak a lot of English, but we were able to get by and the whole experience was great! Highly recommend.
author: Pods83

title: Excellent Massage
text: A cosy spa with very reasonable prices (massage 1 hour Eur42).  Mustafa was my masseur.  He is a truely professional having worked internationally.  His massage is one of the best I’ve had anywhere.  Highly recommended.
